mup_lr_sweep_adjacent_lrs_indistinguisha.note: Not in the abstract; found in the full text. 10 training seeds for this sweep.
mup_lr_sweep_adjacent_lrs_indistinguisha.quote: three adjacent LRs share the per-size best FID, a 1.7x LR window per size

ranking_instability_between_metric_varia.detail: 8 of 25 seeds shift by five or more ranks when guidance tuning is applied.
ranking_instability_between_metric_varia.quote: Spearman rho between the unguided and GS-FID rankings of the 25 training seeds is 0.73
ranking_instability_between_metric_varia.verdict: CONFIRMED, and not in our prompt
ranking_instability_between_metric_varia.why_it_matters: This is the metric-conditional selection failure we measured on the corpus axis of compute-multipliers, appearing independently in generative-model evaluation. Their rho=0.73 between two variants of the SAME metric family is the same phenomenon as our cross-family corpus-axis range of -0.107 to +0.214, and strengthens the claim that selection stability is metric-relative rather than suite-specific.

relative_floor_does_not_shrink_with_comp.quote: Increasing compute or model size barely tightens the spread
relative_floor_does_not_shrink_with_comp.why_it_matters: This is the cross-modal analogue of our resolution-limit result. Our finding is that leaderboard orderings stay unresolvable because gaps shrink as fast as noise does; theirs is that the relative noise floor is a property of the metric rather than of scale. Same structure, different modality, metric and design.

seed_noise_floor_1_to_2_pct_of_mean_fid.quote: holding the FID coefficient of variation (CoV) inside a 1-2% band

threshold_for_calling_a_gain_real.as_published: Treat any FID gap below ~2% as inconclusive, against a measured CoV floor of 1-2% (the abstract gives ~1.3%).
threshold_for_calling_a_gain_real.as_stated_in_our_prompt: a gain below roughly 2x the CoV should not be reported as real
threshold_for_calling_a_gain_real.note: The published rule is an absolute ~2% gap, which is about twice the measured CoV rather than a 2x-CoV rule stated as such. Close to the prompt's paraphrase, but the paper's own number should be quoted, not the paraphrase.

how_we_should_use_it: As independent cross-domain evidence that the resolution limit is not an artifact of language-model scaling, and as a sharper framing of our own point: reproducibility is a property of the metric rather than of compute or scale. Engage the framing rather than citing the number.
